Name: Chocobo Ostrich (CP and AT)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[b][size=3][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod still works in 1.6(you may jsut need to change the Format for the CP version). It will not be updated further though.[/i][/size][/b]

Ostriches can be weird sometimes with their long legs and curved necks.

So I decided to give them a new look, one many look back to in nostalgia and awe...Chocobo! Get your own little Chocobo today! It's a little retexture of the baby and adult Ostrich, that's it. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher and/or Alternative Textures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
